demo.problem: Promotions require a deploy, and an unmeasured discount can trade margin for noise.
demo.goal: Ship discount codes behind a flag and measure whether they improve completed checkouts.
demo.payoff: Marketing can launch safely, prove conversion lift, and roll back without another deploy.

pull_request.title: feat: add discount code support to checkout
pull_request.body: Adds a discount code input to the checkout form. Codes are validated server-side before the order total is calculated.
